speaker: Side A
text: Fellow delegates, it is absolutely undeniable that a global carbon tax is the only way forward. Everyone knows this is the right thing to do. If we don't do this, we are failing our citizens. Our committee must mandate this immediately because the environment is important.

speaker: Side B
text: While the delegate's passion is noted, a universal carbon tax ignores geopolitical realities. According to the UN Economic Report, flat environmental taxes disproportionately harm developing nations, reducing their GDP growth by an estimated 2.4%. We propose tiered emission targets based on historical output instead.
